paite: Tangte lam ah ka mit ka suantou ding a; koi a kipan in ahia panpihna ahong tun ding?
heading: TOUPA, Ei Hon Humbittu
english: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

paite: Hon panpihna tuh TOUPA lei leh van bawlpa a pan ahong tung ding hi.
english: My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.

paite: Ama'n na khe kisuan aphal kei ding a; nangmah chingpa alusu kei ding hi.
english: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.

paite: Ngai in Israelte chingpa alusu in a-ihmu sam kei ding hi.
english: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

paite: TOUPA nangmah chingpa ahi; TOUPA na taklam a nang hon liahpa ahi.
english: Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.

paite: Sun in nisa in ahon hai kei dia, zan in leng kha in ahon sun sam kei ding.
english: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

paite: TOUPA'N hoih lou chiteng a pan ahon ching dia; na hinna aching ding hi.
english: Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.

paite: TOUPA'N na pawt leh na lut aching ding a, tua kipan a, tangtawn in.
english: Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
